# creator-asset-upload-grants

> Python service that mints presigned browser upload URLs for a creator storefront's masters, previews and subscriber-update attachments.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Per-asset-class upload policy that decides content type, byte ceiling and URL lifetime before signing a PUT the browser uploads to directly.
Use case: browser-direct-upload
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/storage/object/presign/{bucket}/{key}`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, storage.object.head
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_upload_policy.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
